_note: Theme registry (F-112). Twelve new Themes from AK_Demo_Catalogue.json themes_new and five existing Mind and Mood Themes from themes_existing_used. Every Theme is clearance_status pending until the UKIPO, USPTO and EUIPO register searches are done (classes 9, 16, 41 and 44). Lines and topics for the existing five are not in the planning pack and are left empty rather than invented. min_books is the board's three-book rule.

themes.name: Work Worth Choosing
themes.line: Guided workbooks for changing jobs, growing a career and talking about your work.
themes.clearance_note: No exact book or app match. Nearby: 'Work That's Worth It' (book quotes page). Rejected first: Meaningful Work (existing book), Career Crossings (college careers service), Work Chapters (coaching site 'Your Next Work Chapter'), Next Career Steps (crowded) [check registers]

themes.name: Purposeful Time
themes.line: Guided workbooks for planning your days, meetings and focused hours.
themes.clearance_note: No exact match. Nearby: two books titled 'Purposeful Productivity' and the app 'Purposeful by Kumanu'. Legal to rule on closeness [check]. Rejected first: Purposeful Hours, because it echoes Bennett's title on the same shelf

themes.name: Shared Direction
themes.line: Guided workbooks for managing people and leading teams.
themes.clearance_note: No exact book or app match. 'Shared leadership' is a known academic term [check]. Rejected first: Leading Others (Mac Lake book), Generous Leading (close to 'Leading Generously', JHU Press)

themes.name: Ventures Taking Shape
themes.line: Guided workbooks for starting and running a small business.
themes.clearance_note: No exact match found. Rejected first: Growing Ventures (book on school garden businesses)

themes.name: Considered Spending
themes.line: Guided workbooks for budgets, bills and everyday money choices.
themes.clearance_note: No exact book or app match found. Rejected first: Thoughtful Money (finance podcast and advisory firm)

themes.name: Money for Later
themes.line: Guided workbooks for saving, irregular income and planning ahead.
themes.clearance_note: No exact book or app match found. Rejected first: Planning Ahead (too close to the app word 'My plan')

themes.name: Raising With Care
